Summary only - this document is not intended to be used without reference to the Financial Services Rule Book, nor can the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority accept responsibility for its accuracy. It remains the user's responsibility to review the source legislation and ensure compliance with the Rule Book requirements.

This table sets out the obligations in the Financial Services Rule Book 2016 for licenceholders under the Financial Services Act 2008 to keep registers.

body: Rule 8.10 (Conflicts of interest register) - responsibility: Compliance officer (8.23); applies to: All Classes except Class 8(1), 8(2)(b) or 8(3); comment: Further particulars in rule 8.10(2)(b).

body: Rule 8.17(3) (Breaches of regulatory requirements) - responsibility: Compliance officer (8.23); applies to: All Classes; comment: This is a register of all breaches. It is not limited to material breaches.

Rule 8.60(3) - Pricing errors (in relation to a collective investment scheme)
body: Rule 8.60(3) (Pricing errors (in relation to a collective investment scheme)) - responsibility: Licenceholder; applies to: All Class 3(1), 3(2), 3(3), 3(4), 3(11) or 3(12); comment: This is a register of all pricing errors. It is not limited to errors of more than 0.5%.
